title: RFK Jr. says Thane Eugene Cesar killed his father
summary: Jesse Michels tells of RFK Jr. says Thane Eugene Cesar killed his father, about 1968 at Los Angeles, US, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: says that his father was not killed by Sir Hans Sirhan but by this guy Eugene Thain Caesar who I believe was a skunk works security guard or something.
you talk to RFK Jr. He'll say my dad was not shot by him. He was shot by or he was shot by him but from the back he was also shot by kind of Eugene Thane Cer who was then a skunk work security guard
tellings.difference: Here Sirhan may also have fired but Cesar shot from behind, where the story says Sirhan did not kill him; this telling also brings in Bob Maheu and Howard Hughes.
tellings.link_reason: Both tell RFK Jr.'s claim that Thane Eugene Cesar, described as a Skunk Works security guard, shot his father in Los Angeles in 1968.

as_told.title: RFK shot from behind by a second gunman

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, retells a claim by Robert F. Kennedy Jr., son of the politician Robert F. Kennedy, who was shot in Los Angeles in 1968. Michels says Kennedy Jr. holds that his father was not killed by Sirhan Sirhan, the man blamed for it, but by a man named Thane Eugene Cesar, who Michels believes was a security guard at Skunk Works, a secret aircraft design shop, and who fired from behind. Michels tells it a few ways, once saying Sirhan may have shot too, once leaving Cesar unnamed, and if true it would mean the killing was not the work of one lone gunman.
